intervention_scope: Current identity descriptors only; IR visual detector unchanged. Within-frame roll is a no-op at one proposal.
matching_scope: Only originally unmatched lost rows and detection columns are eligible. Every original primary pair stays locked. Unique identity evidence explicitly admits reachable edges beyond original geometry.
runtime_scope: CPU cache replay excludes image IO, RGB/IR encoders, detector and offline IR generation; not end-to-end FPS.
